## Goal

What question this answers, in one or two sentences.

## Lane

claude, codex or shared. Files outside your lane need the owner's approval.

## Done when

The evidence or document that would settle it. Research stays offline and in
the simulator.

## Needs the owner?

Say so if this needs a decision, new access, or a change to AGENTS.md, and add
the label `status:needs-user`.
